dataList.name: The Ring's Docent of Fauvism
dataList.desc: Đầu Lượt: Nhận 2 [Protection] for every allied Fauvist Student of the Ring - If this unit used "Critique" in this Encounter, nhận 2 [Protection] and hồi 5 SP instead starting from the vào lượt kế (At lower than -15 SP, double the SP-healing effect) - If there are no allied Fauvist Students of the Ring, nhận 2 [Vulnerable] and reduce this unit's SP down to 0 instead Immediately Before Getting Hit by a Skill that has 1 Phạm Vi Tấn Công, if there is an allied Student of the Ring, have the said unit take the attack instead (2 lần mỗi lượt, excluding Assist Units) Turn End of the turn this unit used "Critique": If an allied Fauvist Student of the Ring was defeated in this Encounter, refill its vacancy with the same Student unit - Every Đầu Lượt: The Student that refilled the vacancy due to this effect gains (# of allies defeated in this Encounter) [Vulnerable] and [AttackDown] (max 10 each)
dataList.summary: Immediately before getting hit, force an allied Student to take the hit instead

dataList.name: Mentorship
dataList.desc: Đầu Lượt: Randomly apply [AttackUp] and [DefenseUp] to allied Fauvist Students of the Ring equal to the number of turns (including the current turn) each unit has survived, respectively (tối đa 5) Cuối Lượt: If an allied Student is Staggered, recover them from Stagger - All Attack Type and Affinity Resistance for the Students who recovered from Stagger due to this effect becomes "Fatal" for the vào lượt kế Cuối Lượt: If a Student is in Panic, hồi their SP up to 45
